newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - LCI Intl said raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - LCI Intl said raised.

text.p: -- PaineWebber raised the rating on LCI International Inc to buy from attractive, according to a PaineWebber source.
LCI said on Wednesday that some shareholders have withdrawn their request for a secondary offering of 1.45 million shares because of the poor performance of long distance company stocks of late.

It also said it expects to report growth in revenues and earnings per share for its fiscal fourth quarter of 1996. The company also said it expects to report minutes growth for the quarter. It did not elaborate.
